propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by their canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key because _haystack excludes these identifiers from the searchable text
a user querying rebar search with an identifier (e.g. REB-1654) gets no results despite rebar show resolving the same identifier correctly, creating a false impression the ticket does not exist

the fix widens _haystack to include lowercased ticket_id, alias, and jira_key; enriches states in the caller search_state with the bound Jira key from the binding store; and ensures case-folding on both query and identifiers so REB-1654 and reb-1654 both match
search_states remains pure (no filesystem or binding-store access) while identifier enrichment and Jira-key injection move to the caller _engine_support/reads.py
